roman.name: Romans
roman.description: The tight formation turns infantry into a wall. Every threshold strengthens the whole team, not just the Romans.

tiers.text: +12 armor and magic resist to all allies
+25 armor and magic resist to all allies
+45 armor and magic resist, +15% health to all allies

gaul.name: Gauls
gaul.description: They fight better when the battle turns against them: every fallen ally raises the surviving Gauls' fury.

tiers.text: +14% attack speed to Gauls, +8% more for every fallen ally
Every fallen ally: +15% attack speed to Gauls. +10% baseline
Every fallen ally: +22% attack speed to Gauls. +25% baseline and 15% of damage dealt stolen as health

teuton.name: Teutons
teuton.description: They enter the field already protected by a shield that absorbs the first hits.

tiers.text: Teutons start with 320 shield and take 8% less damage
Teutons start with 600 shield and take 18% less damage

infantry.name: Infantry
infantry.description: Front line. The more infantry fielded, the longer the front holds.

archer.name: Archer
archer.description: Damage from range: critical hits and increased range.

tiers.text: +40% critical chance, +30% critical damage and +1 range to Archers

cavalry.name: Cavalry
cavalry.description: Opening charge: starts further ahead with a boosted opening strike.

tiers.text: Cavalry's first attack deals 120 bonus damage
The first attack deals 300 bonus damage and Cavalry moves 35% faster

druid.name: Druid
druid.description: Support: steady regeneration for wounded allies.

tiers.text: All allies recover 12 health per second

berserker.description: Attacks also strike enemies adjacent to the target.

tiers.text: Berserkers' attacks deal 25% of the damage to adjacent enemies

siege.name: Siege
siege.description: War machines: damage proportional to the target's maximum health.
